items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the name 'Frank Foster' when corrected by the interviewer. The subsequent anecdote about a loft in the Village refers to Tony Scott ('Tony Scott and… that’s it'), not Frank Foster. No personal interaction or relationship with Frank Foster is described.

ctx.x: Maybe Frank Foster, not Al Foster? Uh, Frank Foster.
